proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4275 article gives Malayalam putu new, fresh; putukuka to be renewed; putukkam newness, a wonderful thing; putukkuka to renew, mend; putuma a novelty, wonderful sight, an entertaining story; puttan a fresh, new thing; puttari new rice used in ceremonies.. The Malayalam survey form pud̪iya “new” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
